By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
This information is used to create and manage your account and provide the core functionality of TagSafe.
The App does not record video or take photos without your explicit action.

If you capture or upload photos (for example, item photos or profile images), these images may be securely stored on our servers to provide App functionality. Photos are never accessed without your action and are not shared publicly unless you explicitly choose to make information visible.
This information helps us improve TagSafe and maintain its reliability.

When a finder contacts you through TagSafe (via our anonymous call relay or contact form), we process the communication metadata (such as timestamps and call duration) required to deliver the service. Finder phone numbers and identities are not shared with you, and your personal contact details are never shared with finders.
